reply.messageText:
Clean adjustments - all three land.

Group cuts by platform means moving from a flat list to platform-grouped structure: Shorts together, X together, LinkedIn together, newsletter together. Easier to scan per surface, easier to approve one platform at a time.

Shorts hook under 20 words is the more native metric anyway - TikTok and Reels are spoken, and word count is how creators actually think about them. Roughly the same energy envelope as ≤90 chars, just counted in words instead of characters.

Flag taboo hits before the cuts moves QC to the top of the output. Anything risky surfaces before you read the drafts - saves the back-and-forth of scrolling past cuts to find a flag at the bottom.

Updated output shape:

QC: [one line - taboo hits, spam risk, dupe risk, voice mismatch]

CUTS:
  SHORTS:
    - Hook (≤20 words, spoken energy)
  X:
    - Post (≤200 chars, one claim)
  LINKEDIN:
    - Post (professional lead + lesson)
  NEWSLETTER:
    - Subject + preview line

I still have the two open questions from my last note - name (working name "creator-repurpose," or pick together?) and reference tone (use the six CD18493E drafts as voice default, or start clean with no carryover from unconfirmed brand state?).

If you want me to start building now with my proposed working defaults, say the word - I'll use "creator-repurpose" as the working name and a clean voice default, and we can rename and retune once you've seen it run on real input.

Talk soon,
